notes: Verifier K, wave 4. Printed: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.' Expectation from the text (CR 601.2b, 601.2h): with no creature of your own to sacrifice the spell cannot be cast at all, even with the mana; it stays in hand, no mana is spent and the opponent's creature is untouched (the opponent's creature cannot pay your cost).
